pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregularly polygonal dark brown regions with deeply indented, star-like boundaries. Edge angularity is high with sharp pixel gradients between dark and light pelage. Patch area is maximal on the upper flank and neck, becoming smaller and more fragmented on the posterior hindquarters.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light cream-colored pathways forming a complex topological graph. Junction nodes are predominantly trivalent. Pixel thickness is variable, exhibiting constriction in regions of dense patching (hindquarters) and widening across the central flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Mane presents as a jagged, low-amplitude 1D silhouette along the upper neck and shoulder ridge. High-frequency serration is visible against the background foliage.
